## Ala (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 CE Medium monstrous humanoid  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +14; **Aura** frightful presence (30 ft., DC 14)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 21, touch 16, flat-footed 18 (+3 deflection, +3 Dex, +5 natural)  
 **hp** 150 (10d10+50)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +10, **Will** +10  
 **Immune** electricity  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** bite +16 (1d6+5 plus poison), 2 claws +15 (1d4+5)  
 **Special Attacks** whirlwind (3/day, 10–30 ft. high, 5 ft. wide at base, 1/2 wide as tall at peak, 2d8+5 damage plus lightning’s kiss, DC 17)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th)  

 1/day—ice storm (DC 13), lightning bolt (DC 12), call lightning storm (DC 14)  

**Tactics**

 In battle, ala twist into black whirlwinds that sweep foes from their feet, battering them with claw, tooth, and electricity. When not in whirlwind form, ala tear at their foes with claws and a poisonous bite, or they throw wicked lightning bolts and hailstorms upon their enemies from a distance. Woes betide the hapless hero who confronts an ala while a storm rages overhead, for such storms energize the ala and enable it to call more powerful bolts.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 20, **Dex** 16, **Con** 18, **Int** 10, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 26  
 **Feats** Alertness, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Flyby Attack, Great Fortitude, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Climb +13, Fly +24, Intimidate +10, Perception +14, Sense Motive +5, Stealth +18, Survival +13; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Fly, +4 Stealth  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic  

**Special Abilities**

 **Lightning’s Kiss (Su)** Jagged bolts of lightning flash inside the ala’s whirlwind, dealing 2d6 electricity damage plus an additional 1d6 electricity damage per ala in whirlwind form within 50 ft.  

 **Poison (Ex)** **Ala poison**: injury—bite; *save* Fort DC 17; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* sickened, sickened creatures are nauseated 1; *cure* 1 save.
